message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: Defendant Deng (邓某) paid large sums to hospital staff (charging money to increase sales of drugs). He bribed hospital staff (charging officer Liu, who passed money to department heads). Also bribed a pharmacist Yang who influenced doctors. This is bribery of medical staff to promote drug sales. The charges likely "受贿" (bribery) for the staff, but for the defendant, he is the briber, so "行贿". The list includes "行贿" and "受贿". The defendant is the one giving money to get improper benefit. So charge: 行贿 (bribery). Also possibly "单位行贿" if he is a unit? He is an individual (maybe a company). The list includes "行贿". Also "受贿" is for recipient. So we choose "行贿". Also maybe "经济犯" (economic crime) but not needed. The examples show they label with "行贿" for bribery cases. So answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>.

Check if any other charge: Could be "非法吸收公众存款"? No. "非法占有" not. So just 行贿.
